scope: Read all 28 passages, overviews, periods, endings, overrides and identity notes. Independently checked selected claims in 8 of 20 sources, including both writing samples. Bounded review, not full historical certification.
corrections: Replaced February 2024 Shawnee writing witness with directly readable Fall 2024 message by the same author; updated quotation capitalization and attribution.

sourcesChecked.checked: Direct tribal announcement: exact Osage Unicode phrase beside Tree of Gifts; 2021 family sponsorship program.
Direct original 2014 encoding proposal identifies authors and modern community alphabet development.
Original indexed tribal preservation study: attributed ancestral geography, AD 1300 westward settlement focus and critical discussion of simplistic pottery-origin equations.
Direct state archaeological-site account: rectangular 30 to 50 by 15 to 20 ft houses, east doors, crops/fishing/gathering and fur commerce. Older speculative origin statements not used.
Direct tribal teaching PDF: bent frames, coverings removed for hunts, benches, smoke openings, several families and Sky/Earth village layout.
Direct Kentucky archaeological survey: mid-eighteenth-century town, diplomacy, 30 by 50 ft Bentley post plan, Native ceramics and imported scissors/knives/mouth harps in shared refuse context.
Direct primary 2022 tribal preservation statement: three brick buildings, 1839 school, Chief Barnes attribution of attic sleeping after field labor; no unconfirmed burial discovery claim.
Direct original Fall 2024 tribal message gives exact capitalized greeting and English meaning; substituted for inaccessible February primary-text witness.
